old_50k_L8_conflict.source_reason: Both legacy loops instantiate and train a fresh flow; the depth loop does not reuse the data-size-axis L8 flow. Training and fast evaluation consume RNG; no identical per-configuration initialization/shuffling/sampling seed is reset in these loops.
old_50k_L8_conflict.evidence_limitation: Historical aggregates and source identify two separate training calls; their selected model states and exact per-run RNG histories were not retained for independent replay.
old_50k_L8_conflict.current_resolution: Exactly one N50000_L8 checkpoint/result per training seed, referenced unchanged in both axes; neither legacy value is selected to match.

table8_table9_comparison.limits: Historical HMC means and one fast evaluation differ from the common present NUTS means/five-fast-seed average. These differences cannot be assigned solely to training-seed variation. Historical active-e1-e3 MAEs were not retained. No formal statistical test is performed.
